text:
Mia Chen: Drafting a super-compact CS handoff note: one health score, trend, top 3 drivers, and a 3-line customer checklist with explicit caching/batching/streaming steps. Keep it non-jargon.

Diego Morales: Good call. Add a 24h delta next to the score so sales see direction not just a number. Suggest bands: <48 = red, 48-68 = amber, >=69 = green.

Ellen Park: For explainability keep a tiny formula: health = round(min(100, 0.35*activation + 0.3*success + 0.2*prefill + 0.15*latency)) and display drivers alongside.

Samir Joshi: Ops mapping bullets (1 line each):
- stream_err_rate >2% for 30m -> open enablement + bump prefill_attempts
- prefill_success <80% -> run controlled prefill: `ri-prefill run --tenant <t> --batch 12 --window 3h --tag cs-trial`
- latency_95p >1500ms -> recommend batch tuning: start batch_size=8, timeout=40ms; safe growth policy: +2 if 95p < SLO for 2 windows.

Mia Chen: Customer-facing checklist (3 lines):
1) We monitor: activation, prefill hits, stream stability.
2) We did: enabled short prefix cache (24h), started small prefill trial, capped max tokens to 2k.
3) Quick simple steps for you: enable non-personal prompt cache, reduce max token length for spikes, confirm most-common prompts list.

CSbot: AUTOGEN SAMPLE (paste as single-line example): `{tenant:acme-corp,health:62,drivers:[prefill:72,activation:54,latency95p_ms:1100],24h_delta:-4,ts:1805551234}`

Diego Morales: Add renewal flag rules: rolling drop >=10 pts over 7d or >3 stream disconnects in 24h -> escalate to AM with suggested remediation checklist.

Ellen Park: Feedback capture: 48h micro-survey with 3 Qs (prefill improved? Y/N; regressions? text; rate 1-5). Store as event for next snapshot.

Mia Chen: I'll assemble the 1-paragraph customer note + 1-page CS pocket card and post for review Fri AM. Reviewers: @Diego, @Ellen.

Samir Joshi: LGTM, will add SRE run commands after draft.
